title: 8 Out of 10 Crime Writers Do Countdown
description: There will be consonants and vowels, there will be numbers and conundrums. There will be Steve Cavanagh, Andi Osho, Mark Billingham and Liz Nugent. There will be a lot of laughs and more than a bit of chaos. Craig Robertson will be in control (?!) of proceedings and an unruly bunch of crime writers. He will be ably assisted by Luca Veste on numbers and Elly Griffiths in Dictionary Corner. We are legally obliged to state that this event will bear no resemblance to a certain Channel 4 show with a strikingly similar format and name. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf

title: A History of Modern Britain in Twenty Murders: Professor David Wilson
description:
The Albert Halls -
Seated

Door Times: 4.30pm

Tickets: £15.00 – £16.00

We wrap up the 2026 festival in style with a fascinating hour in the company of one of the UK’s leading criminologists. Professor David Wilson will explore what the country’s most brutal murderers reveal about us in a thrilling blend of history and true crime.

Based on his groundbreaking book A History of Modern Britain in Twenty Murders, Professor Wilson will lead us through killings from Jack the Ripper and the “Brides in the Bath”, to the tragic murders of James Bulger and Sarah Everard. This event is a must-see for true crime aficionados.

This event will be chaired by literary agent Jenny Brown.

description:
Come and join An Abba Dream, the UK top Abba tribute show … you will not be disappointed.

This show tours theatres all over the UK all year long. For the best Abba Christmas party in town, sing along to all your favourite hits like Mama Mia, Waterloo, Does Your Mother Know and of course Dancing Queen.

address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Ardal O'Hanlon
description: Oh, it’s all there! All the trademarks are in evidence in Ardal’s latest show. Beautifully crafted stand-up comedy? Yes. Celebrated use of language? Tick. Lateral thinking, surreal flourishes, sharp observations? Of course. As for the occasional profundity? Maybe. Despite his best attempts over many decades to put the world to rights, it is still a colossal mess. And so, Ardal has no choice but to go out on the road again. Like the good comedy doctor he is, he fearlessly diagnoses the various pathologies and neuroses that are currently ravaging humanity. Disclaimer: No solutions provided. After an alarming experience at the supermarket, Ardal reflects on who he is as a man and a comedian. He examines his own ethnic and religious background. And thinks twice about the very core of his identity as a voice of reason. Is everything a big lie? With no major trauma of his own to draw on for material, apart from the drag of getting older, he also turns his gaze outwards at the joys and follies of contemporary life. Towel Animals? A.I.? Chair Yoga? Cauliflower as a main course? Yes. Yes. Yes. And Yes. No current idiocy is left unexamined.With a highly developed sense of the ridiculous, and proper comedy bones, NOT HIMSELF, is a testament to the healing power of humour. And the joy of jokes. Ardal is not only an acclaimed stand-up comedian who has performed world-wide. He will be familiar to many from his appearances in TV shows such as TASKMASTER and WOULD I LIE TO YOU?, leading roles in DEATH IN PARADISE, FR TED, and MY HERO as well as cameos in DERRY GIRLS, THE WOMAN IN THE WALL, RETURN TO PARADISE and ROSIE MOLLOY GIVES UP EVERYTHING. He will soon be seen in the feature film, FRAN THE MAN, and the new Netflix series, HOW TO GET TO HEAVEN FROM BELFAST, as well as the CW drama, SHERLOCK AND DAUGHTER. Ardal is currently writing his third novel. 16+, u18s must be accompaned by an adult
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Celine - My Heart Will Go On
description: After a sold out tour across the UK and Europe in 2023, Celine – My Heart Will Go On is back, bigger and better than ever! The concert is a stunning celebration of the music of one of the greatest singers of our time. Step into the world of Celine Dion like never before with My Heart Will Go On, a breathtaking concert experience that brings the legendary singer’s iconic hits to life. This electrifying production has been wowing audiences across Europe for four years, earning critical acclaim and rave reviews for its powerhouse performances and unforgettable musical journey. Featuring a sensational live band, My Heart Will Go On takes concertgoers on a thrilling ride through four decades of Celine Dion’s greatest songs. From timeless classics like The Power of Love and It’s All Coming Back to Me Now to the soulful All By Myself and the unforgettable ballad My Heart Will Go On, each performance captures the magic and heart of Celine’s unparalleled career. A must-see for fans and music lovers alike, this celebration of Celine Dion’s music promises to leave you inspired, moved, and filled with the energy of her extraordinary legacy. Don’t miss your chance to experience the music that has touched hearts around the world. Join us for an unmissable evening as we pay homage to the Queen of Power Ballads Experience the next best thing to the real artist.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Christmas - The Candlelight Concert
description: ✨ Experience the Magic of ‘Christmas – The Candlelight Concert’ ✨ A Sophisticated Festive Celebration by Xperience Live Step into a world of festive elegance and timeless charm as Xperience Live proudly presents ‘Christmas – The Candlelight Concert’ - an evening where music, candlelight and holiday wonder come together in perfect harmony. Set beneath the soft glow of countless candles, this enchanting concert promises to warm your heart and stir your soul. Be transported by the breathtaking vocals of our exceptional singers and the rich, live sounds of our talented band as they breathe new life into the Christmas classics you know and love. From the very first notes of ‘It’s Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas’, you’ll be swept into a yuletide reverie filled with nostalgia and joy. This unforgettable evening will feature a curated selection of beloved favourites, including ‘White Christmas’, ‘Santa Baby’, ‘Winter Wonderland’, and many more - all performed live with elegance and flair. Whether you’re enjoying the company of loved ones or simply soaking in the glow of the season, Christmas – The Candlelight Concert is the perfect way to celebrate in style. This heart-warming event invites families, friends and festive romantics alike to revel in the spirit of a truly Holly Jolly Christmas. So join us for a night of unforgettable music, magical atmosphere and holiday sophistication. It’s not just a concert — it’s a Christmas memory in the making. Tickets are limited – secure your place and make this Christmas truly extraordinary. Tickets £44.40/£39.10/£33.80/£28.50 incl cmsn + £2 bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Club 80s Live
description: Fun and sunshine, there’s enough for everyone: Club 80s is coming to town. Hits by Dexys Midnight Runners, Culture Club, Guns N’ Roses, Frankie Goes to Hollywood, Erasure, Bon Jovi, Wham!, Deacon Blue, and many, many more are crammed into a non-stop, musical trip – back-combed to the time that fashion forgot! A band tighter than a Spandex leotard, dancers shining brighter than all the neon in Vegas, are backed by a cast that stands head and shoulder pads above the rest – in a show where the costume changes come just as thick and fast as the hits. So, give the Rubik’s Cube a night off and have yourself a night to remember. Whether you were workin’ as a waitress in a cocktail bar or just a city boy, let Club 80s take your hand back to the happiest days of your life. This show includes amazing sound and light, with big screen visuals, and includes a mind blowing illusion that sees a mannequin turn in to a real girl in front of the audience's eyes, as they sing the amazing Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now. An amazing show that cannot be missed !!!!! Amazing audiences since 2013, this is a show that has to be seen. It’s the ultimate night out and a night you won’t forget. Ticket: £29.56 (incl. £2 booking fee)
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Death on the Island
description: In the skilled hands and twisted mind of a crime writer, the dark beauty of Scottish islands offers the perfect landscape for tales of murder and mystery. Lin Anderson’s The High Island is the first in a thrilling new series set on the rugged Isle of Hoy in Orkney. Blood on Old Stones, the 23rd in Alex Gray’s much-loved DSI Lorimer series sees a double killing on Mull. A brutal murder on a deserted beach on South Uist is the driver for Andrew Raymond’s atmospheric novel The Long Isle. This event will be chaired by author Zoe Venditozzi. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presents Jane Harper & Jane Casey
description: It’s a case of Double Jane-pardy (sorry!) as two fabulous storytellers from opposite ends of the world get together to discuss their work. Jane Harper is the queen of rural Australian noir and an international bestseller. Her global smash The Dry was made into a major movie. Jane’s new novel, Last One Out, is a deeply atmospheric smalltown mystery. Jane Casey is a number one bestseller but Everything She Didn’t Say is her first book set in her native Ireland. It’s a riveting mystery about female friendship, betrayal and survival. Jane and Jane will be interviewed by Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presents Lee Child
description: We welcome back a legend of the genre and the creator of possibly the most iconic protagonist in thriller fiction. Lee Child has many imitators, but he and Jack Reacher remain the gold standard to which they all aspire. Travelling with just the clothes on his back and a toothbrush, Reacher is a hero for the ages. Over the course of 30 pulsating novels, Lee has sold an incredible 100 million books which have been adapted into two movies starring Tom Cruise and a hit TV series. He will look back on an extraordinary career with guest programmer Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presents Lucy Foley
description: When the Agatha Christie estate sought someone to write the first new Miss Marple novel in 50 years, they sought an author who could mix modern suspense with a deep understanding of the original Christie voice. As a long-standing Christie superfan and an international number one bestseller, Lucy Foley – author of The Hunting Party and The Guest List – was the ideal candidate. Murder at the Grand Alpine Hotel retains the cozy feel of Dame Agatha’s books but also dives into the darker side of humanity that underscored her work. Lucy will be in conversation with guest programmer Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presents SA Cosby
description: We are delighted to welcome one of the most dynamic voices in crime fiction on his first visit to Stirling. Over the course of five exceptional novels, SA Cosby has firmly established himself as the genre’s rising star. With the breathtaking Blacktop Wasteland, and the unforgettable Razorblade Tears Shawn has racked up awards and acclaim in equal measure and achieved global success. Shawn’s homeland is the American south which he again depicts brilliantly in his latest novel, the exhilarating King of Ashes. It is a gritty tale of family and secrets and is a powerful reminder that nothing lasts forever. Shawn will be interviewed by Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presents Tana French
description: One of the world’s most lauded crime writers, Tana French was born in the USA, raised in Italy, the USA, Ireland and Malawi, and has grown to be the First Lady of Irish crime. Her mesmerising novels have won the Edgar, Anthony, Macavity and Barry awards, as well as the prestigious LA Book Prize. Her latest page-turning mystery is The Keeper, a masterful tale of grudges, power struggles and murder in a remote Irish village. We’re excited to welcome Tana on her first visit to Bloody Scotland where she will be interviewed by guest programmer Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Denise Mina presets Ardal O'Hanlon
description: Careful now. Much-loved comedian and actor Ardal O’Hanlon will be neither small nor far away but on stage in the Albert Halls to discuss his crime fiction debut. The star of Father Ted, My Hero, and Death in Paradise has previously written two novels but has now turned to crime with A Plot to Die For, the first in a dazzling new mystery series. It’s small-town Ireland meets big-time murder as a celebrity gardener tries to solve a killing or two amid the fanatical fever of the annual Tidy Towns competition. Ardal will be in conversation with guest programmer Denise Mina. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Dept Q: Scott Frank, Matthew Goode, Kate Dickie, Alexej Manvelo, Leah Byrne
description: Quirky, quick-witted and quantifiably quality, Dept. Q is quite possibly the hottest crime series on television. The Edinburgh-set show has been a huge worldwide hit on Netflix, and we’re delighted to welcome its creator and stars to Bloody Scotland. Joining us will be showrunner Scott Frank and stars Matthew Goode (DCI Carl Morck), Kate Dickie (Chief Superintendent Moira Jacobson), Alexej Manvelov (Akram Salim) and Leah Byrne (DC Rose Dickson) . Together, they will discuss how the show has achieved such cult status amongst fans and reveal behind-the-scenes secrets as they take a break from filming Series 2. This is definitely not to be missed! The session will be chaired by the executive producer of the show, Rob Bullock. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Femmes Fatales: Liz Nugent, Harriet Tyce, Andrea Mara
description: Three superb authors, three novels overflowing with brilliant characters, three books that will have you questioning everything that you read. This should not be missed. Liz Nugent unveils possibly her most unforgettable creation yet in her latest deliciously dark novel The Truth About Ruby Cooper. There is twist after twist and the truth is always just out of reach in the exceptional Witch Trial by Traitors’ star Harriet Tyce. Friendship, truth and lives are on the line in the relentlessly suspenseful Such a Nice Girl by the brilliant Andrea Mara. This event will be chaired by broadcaster Bryan Burnett. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Forever Clapton
description: A brand new production for 2026 and outstanding tribute to one of the most iconic Blues and Rock guitarists of all time! Forever Clapton is a fully LIVE 6 piece showband that along with audio-visual displays tells the story of the incredible guitarist Eric Clapton. Taking you through Clapton's career from 1965 to present day, from the Blues Breakers, to Cream, Derek and the Dominos, and of course those unplugged performances. This faultless show is performed by Benny "guitar" Smith, who along with his hand picked band perform all the greats such as - I shot the Sheriff, Lay down Sally, Cocaine, Crossroads, Holy mother, Layla and so many more iconic songs in this near 2 hour show.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Gary Meikle - Your Maw
description: Gary Meikle returns to the stage with another new show which has quickly become the yearly norm for him now. Hi guys it’s me, Gary. These blurbs do my head in if I’m honest, each year I need to sit and write one out before I even know what stories I’m gonna share, well I mean I don’t have to write one I could pay something else to do it but f that they’d just write some mundane vague crap which I can clearly do myself. At least this way you know I've written it personally. So what's the new show about? Again, I don’t yet, but it will contain at least one ‘yer maw’ Joke, what I do know is that it’ll be another brand new 80-90 minutes of stories, opinions and observations about me, and my family as well as you all its always about people and the mad shit we do, sometimes animals but more often than not it's about people and the stupid scenarios we end up in. I wonder if that's now enough wordage to cover the minimum blurb requirement? I guess we'll see, and I’ll see you all soon maybe - oh, one last thing, my show isn’t suitable for small people, some of it might be about them, in fact it definitely will but, yeah they ain’t getting in :) Tickets £23 in advance + £2 booking fee per ticket On the door £26 Age restriction 18+
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Georgie Carroll: Infectious
description: Georgie Carroll is back with her brand-new show, INFECTIOUS An undeniable live comedy powerhouse and a natural storyteller, she’s razor sharp and riotous. Nurse turned comedian, Georgie Carroll is not only brilliantly funny, she is unstoppable on the comedy circuit having performed her smash hit award winning show Sista Flo 2.0 for three solid years of sold out seasons (UK, NZ, AU) . Don’t miss her brand new show! “Really Funny… Just Brilliant’’ Simon Cowell ★★★★★ “Exceptional” Mervyn Stutters Pick of The Fringe ★★★★★ "Nurse Georgie Carroll proves that laughter is the best medicine & you cannot miss your dose!" Lost in Theatre Land UK ★★★★★ ''Sublime comedy'' Glam Adelaide ★★★★★ "Rollicking, riotous comedy'' The Age For more Georgie visit https:www.georgiecarroll.com 14+, u18s must be accompanied by an adult
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Hotel California
description: Hotel California, a seven piece ensemble of musicians will perform their spectacular new critically acclaimed show that gives you a concert experience of 100 minutes of pure Eagles nostalgia. You’ll return to a dark desert highway, cool wind in your hair, or stand on that street corner in Winslow, Arizona when you join Hotel California as they faithfully re-create The Eagles and their Californian Sunshine Rock sound. Expect a set that includes tracks from the outstanding Long Road Out Of Eden album. The Eagles’ music is timeless, appealing to audiences of every age, bringing back memories and touching the hearts and souls of each new generation. This concert promises to be a fantastic night to remember for all Eagles fans, young and old, new or long-standing
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Cai Jun and Yrsa Sigurðardóttir
description: In a Bloody Scotland first, we are proud to welcome one of Asia’s most prolific and popular crime authors to Stirling. Cai Jun is the leading crime and horror writer in China – their answer to Stephen King – and his books have sold an incredible 14 million copies worldwide. Alongside Cai Jun will be the Queen of Icelandic Noir, the wonderful Yrsa Sigurðardóttir whose multi-award-winning books have been translated into more than 30 languages. She too leans to the darker side of crime with a tinge of horror thrown in. Cai Jun and Yrsa will be interviewed by Craig Sisterson. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Chris Brookmyre and Abir Mukherjee
description: Grab your ticket for an unmissable hour in the company of two of Scotland’s finest crime writers. It is 30 years since crime fiction’s most infamous mantlepiece featured in Chris Brookmyre’s debut novel Quite Ugly One Morning. Now, three decades later his irrepressible investigative journalist Jack Parlabane returns in the ingenious Quite Ugly One Evening. Abir Mukherjee follows his award-winning bestseller Hunted with the equally action-packed and thought-provoking thriller The Pinnacle which sees murder strike on the 65th floor of Mumbai’s grandest luxury skyscraper. Chris and Abir will be chaired by broadcaster Nicola Meighan. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Gregg Hurwitz and Robert Bryndza
description: What better way to spend your Sunday than in the company of two of the best thriller writers at work today? New York Times number one bestseller Gregg Hurwitz is the master of high-octane thrills translated into 33 languages and devoured by fans across the globe. His lates hit, Antihero, is non-stop action. Robert Bryndza’s chilling debut The Girl in the Ice topped charts in the UK, USA and Australia and kickstarted the sales of five million books worldwide. His new page-turner is The Quiet Kill. This event will be chaired by broadcaster Bryan Burnett. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Jeremy Vine and Matthew Sweet
description: Seize your ticket for two talented and entertaining speakers who guarantee an hour of laughs and insight into the world of books and television. One of the most familiar faces on television (and voices on radio) has turned his considerable talents to crime fiction. Turn the Dial for Death is Jeremy Vine’s fabulous second book featuring radio presenter Edward Temmis. Matthew Sweet is the genius behind Bookish, the hit TV series starring Mark Gattis. His second novel, Bookish Volume 11, sees Gabriel Book investigating a mystery that’s haunted him for a decade. This event will be chaired by broadcaster Nicola Meighan. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Steve Cavanagh and Nadine Matheson
description: These two former lawyers have turned to a life of crime, which is great news for us as they’re creating some of the most entertaining novels in the business. Nadine Mathieson’s barnstorming debut The Jigsaw Man established her as the creator of deliciously dark novels, and she continues to delight with the gory new thriller The Shadow Carver. Steve Cavanagh’s brilliant, and hugely popular series about conman turned defense attorney Eddie Flynn is an international hit, and Eddie returns in the brilliant One of Us Is Guilty. Steve and Nadine will be chaired by reviewer Ayo Onatade. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: In Conversation: Val McDermid and Denise Mina
description: Join two of the biggest names in Scottish crime fiction for an extra special final event to wrap up Bloody Scotland 2026. Between them, they have published more than 60 novels, been translated into more than 40 languages and have sales in the multi-millions. Val's latest novel (co-written with Jo Sharp) is This Door of the Seas. Part of the acclaimed Darkland Tales series, it is an epistolary historical novel about the late 17th-century Darien Venture - Scotland's ill-fated attempt to establish a trading colony in the jungles of Central America. Denise's latest novel is The Good Liar, a standalone thriller in which blood spatter expert Claudia O’Shiel finds herself with a critical choice to make that might put her life on the line. This event will be chaired by the literary agent Jenny Brown. Tickets £14.75/£13.75
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Jimmy Nail
description: STORIES AND SONGS 2026 Acclaimed actor, singer, musician and writer — and proud Geordie icon — Jimmy Nail heads out on the road in 2026 with Stories and Songs, a series of intimate retrospective shows reflecting on an extraordinary seven-decade career. From the landmark television series Auf Wiedersehen, Pet to Spender and then Crocodile Shoes — which spawned multi-platinum albums and chart-topping singles — Jimmy Nail has left an indelible mark on British popular culture. His career spans hit records, television series, major film roles including Evita and Still Crazy, and leading performances on both Broadway and London’s West End. Following a recent run of sell-out shows in Newcastle, celebrating the songs of Crocodile Shoes, Jimmy now brings audiences something more personal. Stories and Songs is a warm, witty and revealing evening that blends music, memories and rarely seen images. Audiences can expect candid anecdotes, moments of reflection, and a hand-picked selection of songs drawn from across his remarkable career. And with a catalogue this rich, no two nights will be quite the same. From the 1992 UK number one “Ain’t No Doubt”, to “Love Don’t Live Here Anymore”, “Crocodile Shoes”, “Cowboy Dreams”, “Big River”, and music from film and stage, the choices are many — and the stories behind them just as compelling. Jimmy will be joined on stage by long-time collaborator Tony Davis on keyboards and accordion, adding texture and atmosphere to these stripped-back, intimate performances. An evening of Stories and Songs is not just a concert, it’s a journey — through music, memory, and a life lived on stage and screen.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: John Lydon - I Could be Wrong, I Could be Right
description: He’s a legend and an icon, a revolutionary and an immortal. John Lydon – aka Johnny Rotten – changed the face of music and sparked a cultural revolution. The frontman and lyricist of the Sex Pistols and Public Image Ltd (PiL) caused a political earthquake and transformed music for good. To coincide with the publication of his new book, the brilliant, funny and insightful I Could Be Wrong, I Could Be Right, he is touring the UK. Lydon will talk about how he sees life, along with his unique and extraordinary career, and take audience questions during a pyrotechnic, one-off tour. Lydon will be sharing his thoughts with audiences. He Could Be Wrong. He Could Be Right. VIP and meet’n’greet packages are available. Signed copies of the book will be available 14+, u18s must be accompanied by an adult
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Nice and Cosy: Janice Hallett, Steve Higgs, Olly Smith
description: Get comfortable for an hour of charm and criminal creativity in the company of three doyens of dastardly delight. The Silent Appeal is the hugely anticipated sequel to Janice Hallett’s runaway bestseller, The Appeal as murder strikes in Lower Lockwood. A retired detective and his dog Rex Harrison are on the trail of criminals and tasty treats in Steve Higgs’ hilarious Pork Pie Pandemonium. TV wine expert Olly Smith pours his heart into a vintage cosy crime tale with his corking and full-bodied debut Death by Noir. This event will be chaired by broadcaster Nicola Meighan. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Regular Music presents Tam Cowan
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Richard Osman with Mark Billingham
description: When Richard Osman last appeared at Bloody Scotland in 2019, he was an unpublished author best known for presenting Pointless and House of Games. Fast forward seven years and things have changed remarkably. Beginning with The Thursday Murder Club, Richard has broken all sorts of records in the process of becoming a global publishing phenomenon. His novels have sold an incredible 17 million books worldwide and translated into 40 languages. His new thriller We Chase Shadows races from Italy to Palm Springs to Barcelona in pursuit of a killer. Richard will be interviewed by fellow bestselling crime writer Mark Billingham. Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Russell Watson - An Intimate Evening with 'The Voice'
description: Get ready for an unforgettable night with one of the world’s most captivating performers. Russell Watson – the original crossover superstar – exploded onto the music scene with The Voice, a debut album that shattered records and won hearts across the globe. Since then, he’s sold millions of albums, performed for royalty, presidents and popes, and shared the stage with musical legends. Now, in his most intimate tour to date, Russell takes you on a journey through the highs and lows of an extraordinary life – from chart-topping success to surviving not one, but two life-threatening illnesses. With warmth, humour, and a voice that soars, he’ll share the personal stories behind the spotlight. Expect powerful renditions of beloved classics, spine-tingling vocals, and behind-the-scenes tales from a man who’s truly lived it all. This is more than a concert – it’s a rare chance to spend an evening up close with The Voice himself.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Stirling Mini Melodies
description:
Looking for a joyful Friday morning activity for you and your little one? 🎶👶 Join Stirling Mini Melodies, a warm and welcoming weekly music group for babies, toddlers, and their parents and carers. Through songs, movement, sensory play and simple instruments, little ones can explore rhythm and melody while building confidence, coordination and early communication skills – all while having lots of fun! Expect a relaxed, inclusive atmosphere where grown-ups are encouraged to join in too, creating special moments through shared musical experiences. And because we know parents deserve a treat, free tea and coffee will be available after each session – the perfect chance to unwind and meet other local families.

  • Sensory-rich musical play
  • Singing, movement and instruments
  • Parent and carer participation encouraged
  • Free tea and coffee after class
  • Free to attend!
Classes run Fri 21 Aug – Fri 9 Oct, 10:30am–11:30am 📍 Lesser Hall, The Albert Halls Please note sessions on 18 & 25 Sept will take place in the Attic at Tolbooth (upstairs with lift access). FREE | Booking required Suitable for babies and toddlers with their parent or carer. One adult booking covers up to two infants (please let us know how many children will be attending when booking). 👉 Music plays a vital role in early years development, supporting language, physical coordination and emotional wellbeing – so come along, sing, play and make new connections with other families. Find out more and book your place at StirlingEvents.org, or get in touch with our Box Office. 🎵💛
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Susan Calman: Tall Tales
description: Susan Calman hasn’t been on tour in ten years, but now she’s back with a brand-new show. A decade older, but not necessarily wiser, Susan has found herself in some improbable situations over the years. Tall tales is a show about Cruising, driving tanks, cats and getting older. You might have seen her on the television or heard her on the radio but the absolute best way to see her is live on stage. You won’t believe how short she really is. Prepare yourself for an evening of barely believable stories, laughter and probably some dancing. As seen on Grand Day Out, Cruising with Susan Calman, QI, House of Games and (a long time ago) Strictly Come Dancing. 14+, under 18s must be accompanied by a responsible adult 7.30PM PROMPT START
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: T.Rextasy
description: I Love to Boogie Marc Bolan, with his band T.Rex, was one of the most flamboyant and charismatic stars of the original glam rock era. With Bolan's special ingredient of Rock-a-Boogie songs, the band had a string of huge hits throughout the 1970s including Get it On, Telegram Sam, Jeepster and 20th Century Boy. One of their best loved songs, of course was I Love to Boogie, released in 1976. This year T.Rextasy will be celebrating the 50th Anniversary of this iconic hit which will always be associated with West End Musical ‘Billy Elliot’ T.Rextasy have now been performing around the world for over 20 years, a career that ironically out lives Marc’s very own T.Rex. The band is now accepted as the world’s only official live tribute band dedicated to Marc Bolan & T.Rex, and the only band endorsed and approved by Marc Bolan’s family, estate, original ex-members of T.Rex, and Bolan’s catalogue management. The band has been described by many as ‘beyond the boundaries of tribute’. Truly a rock’n’roll concert for all ages - If you would like to know exactly what a Marc Bolan concert was like in the 1970s, this show is for you! www.trextasy.com QUOTES T.Rextasy – awarded the accolade of ‘The Best Live Tribute Band in the UK ’ by BBC1 TV. ‘They’re the closest you’re ever going to get to the real thing’ - Bill Legend (original T.Rex drummer) ‘T.Rextasy are the tribute act who break all the rules by being bloody brilliant. Danielz is an exact replica of Marc, he’s uncanny. - The Independent on Sunday ‘Danielz is a curator of Bolan’s life, a perfectionist protector of the legacy – T.Rextasy play with a poignant, flamboyant skill.’ - The Observer “Danielz looks and sounds uncannily like Bolan and has dedicated his life to the man” – The Times “Danielz is more than a career lookalike. Here we have a serious guitarist with the animal grace of early Bolan and the clear unequivocal love of the music” – The Stage “Danielz just freaks me out!” – Mickey Finn (original T.Rex percussionist)
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Drifters
description: The Drifters are back on tour in the UK performing all their classic hits including ‘Saturday Night at the Movies', ‘You’re More Than A Number,’ ‘Come on Over to My Place’, ‘Under the Boardwalk’, ‘Kissin’ In The Back Row’ and many more! The legendary group have been inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, performed for the President of the United States and listed among the Greatest Artists of All Time by Rolling Stone magazine. Under the guidance of Tina Treadwell (daughter of the group’s original founders, George & Faye Treadwell) The Drifters have enjoyed a remarkable resurgence in recent years with multiple successful UK tours including headline shows in major arenas and, most notably, the world famous Royal Albert Hall in London for the first ever time in the group’s glittering career. "I am thrilled with the success of our recent UK tours and we invite you all to join us in continuing to celebrate this incredible and everlasting story of The Drifters” said Tina, speaking about the tour. If you require accessible seating please contact the venue. Tickets £32.86 incl cmsn + £2 booking fee per ticket
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Kill Switch: Robert Peston
description: One of the UK’s most familiar faces comes to Stirling as we welcome ITV Political Editor Robert Peston in his less familiar role as bestselling author. The veteran journalist and TV presenter has turned his talents to novels, and his third offering is the explosive thriller The Kill Switch. When the UK Prime Minister collapses and dies during an interview on journalist Gil Peck’s podcast, foul play is confirmed and Peck becomes the prime suspect, forcing him to investigate the government's shadowy contract with a global tech giant. Robert will be interviewed by Catherine Salmond Tickets £14.75/£13.75 incl bf
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Music of James Bond
description: From the moment the first chord strikes, audiences are transported into the mysterious and thrilling world of James Bond. This incredible Chamber Orchestra brings the legendary music of James Bond to life in a way that is bold, elegant and utterly unforgettable. This is more than a concert - it is an orchestral tribute to one of cinema’s most iconic legacies. Across six decades, the music of Bond has been defined by extraordinary voices: Dame Shirley Bassey, whose soaring performances of “Goldfinger”, “Diamonds Are Forever” and “Moonraker” set the gold standard; Adele, whose Oscar-winning “Skyfall” became an instant classic; Sam Smith’s haunting “Writing’s On the Wall”; and Billie Eilish’s powerful and poignant “No Time To Die”. These songs - and the artists behind them - have given Bond its unmistakable sound. Performed by world-class musicians and vocalists, every note echoes the sophistication of the James Bond universe. The sound of sweeping strings and bold brass stirs images of high-speed car chases, exotic escapes and unforgettable encounters. The sultry tones of the singers evoke Bond’s timeless glamour. This is a night where music and cinema intertwine, where audiences don’t just listen to - they feel it, they live it. The Great British Film Orchestra is dedicated to celebrating the soundtracks that have defined the golden age of cinema and beyond. With each performance, we honour the artistry of composers and storytellers who have given us moments that transcend the screen. So, don your finest attire, raise a glass and prepare for an evening of breathtaking music and the unmistakable thrill of James Bond. Disclaimer: This concert is an independent tribute production. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any rights holders of the James Bond franchise. Titles are used solely to describe the musical programme to audiences. Tickets £47.70*, £42.40*, £37.10*, £31.80* *includes cmsn + £2 booking fee per ticket
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Nashville Country Experience
description: Presented by GLK Promotions Ltd The Nashville Country Experience is best described as a well balanced blend of both traditional and modern American country music. A tribute to all the greats such as Johnny Cash, Garth Brooks, Glen Campbell, George Jones ,Luke Combs, Tim Mcgraw and many more, An interactive good humour fun family show that spans the complete spectrum of country genres from blue grass to country blues rock. Make sure you get your tickets for a country music night to remember Tickets £29.68 incl booking fee
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Scottish Christmas Songbook
description: 'THE SCOTTISH CHRISTMAS SONGBOOK is a joyful festive concert featuring Eddi Reader, Karen Matheson, John McCusker, Kris Drever, Ian Carr, Kevin McGuire and the Scottish Christmas Songbook Brass Ensemble. Bursting with seasonal favourites and celebratory energy, it’s the perfect night out to get you straight into the Christmas spirit.’ Suitable for all ages
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Scottish Pink Floyd
description: The Scottish Pink Floyd – Greatest Hits Live in 2026 Get ready for an unforgettable night as The Scottish Pink Floyd, Scotland’s premier Pink Floyd tribute band, brings their Greatest Hits spectacular to town in 2026! This sensational 11 piece ensemble delivers two and a half hours of expertly crafted renditions of all the classics—from The Dark Side of the Moon, Wish You Were Here, and The Wall, to The Division Bell, and more. Expect a full immersive experience of sonic excellence and visual flair: dazzling light shows, laser projections, cinema quality visuals, and authentic sound effects all work in perfect harmony to recreate the vibe of a true Pink Floyd concert. With decades of commitment to faithful performances and a deep passion for the Floyd legacy, this is a show that even the most devoted fans will applaud. Their Greatest Hits show is ideal both for long time Floyd lovers and newcomers ready to discover the drama and beauty of this legendary music. Whether you're dancing, singing along, or simply soaking it in, it's an electric evening guaranteed to deliver goosebumps. Don’t miss your chance to catch The Scottish Pink Floyd live in town in 2026—an unforgettable tribute to one of rock’s greatest bands.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: The Upbeat Beatles
description: This is a quote from the back of the Beatles 4th album “When, in a generation or so, a radio-active, cigar-smoking child, picnicking on Saturn, asks you what the Beatle affair was all about – ‘Did you actually know them?’ – don’t try to explain all about the long hair and the screams! Just play their music.” With sheer joy and energy The Upbeat Beatles will take you on a journey through the earth-shattering sounds of the FAB 4! Throw away all your inhibitions! No band does it better than The Upbeat Beatles.
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: We Three Kings of Country
description: The Music of Johnny Cash, Hank Williams & Jim Reeves From the producers of We Three Kings – of Rock n Roll Johnny Cash Performed by Dave Bogle, engages with the audience, classic songs ‘Folsom Prison Blues’, ‘Ghost Riders in the Sky’ & ‘A Boy named Sue’ and there is plenty more were they came from! Multi talented Dave Bogle, has performed everywhere from the ‘West End’ to ‘Nashville’, playing various rolls in various Shows, today Dave performs and celebrate the music of one of his hero’s Johnny Cash Marc Robinson renowned for playing Buddy Holly all over Great Britain has a love for Hank Williams that can be seen in his performance as he sings ‘I Saw the Light’, ‘Take these Chains’ & ‘Howlin at the Moon’. Lee Davidge, one of the founders of the Rock n Roll Group Red Alert sensitively plays the Ballard’s of Jim Reeves (known as Gentleman Jim). Dressed in his authentic costume, this is an evening to sit back relax and sing along to the timeless classics ‘Welcome to my World’, ‘I Love you Because’, & of course the happy sound of ‘Bimbo’! Suits all ages as long as you’re prepared for a classic Country Music Evening! Pure Country Magic! Ticket £21.20 incl cmsn (+ booking fee)
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL

title: Whitney - The Candlelight Concert
description: Prepare for an electrifying night as Xperience Live presents - Whitney - The Candlelight Concert - bringing you the unforgettable music of Whitney Houston in a tribute like no other! This breathtaking show will feature a world-class live band with one of the UKs leading Whitney Houston tribute artists, delivering Whitney’s greatest hits with an amazing passion and energy. In the glow of hundreds of candles, feel the thrill of Whitney's iconic songs, including "I Wanna Dance with Somebody," "One Moment in Time," "I'm Every Woman," and "I Will Always Love You," performed with the dynamic presence of a live band. From soaring ballads to dance-floor anthems, every note will immerse you in the power and emotion of her legendary catalogue of hits. This is more than a concert - it’s an experience that captures the heart and soul of Whitney Houston. Secure your tickets now, and don’t miss this incredible show!
address: The Albert Halls, Dumbarton Road, Stirling, FK8 2QL
